name: logm
expr: L = logm(S); err = max(max(abs(expm(L) - S))); La = logm(A); erra = max(max(abs(expm(La) - A)));
comment: Sig: L = logm(A). Matrix logarithm for symmetric positive-definite A via eig: L = V*diag(log(eig))*V'. Round-trip expm(logm) = A to ulp. Extended in 2026-08 via inverse scaling and squaring Schur algorithm for general real and complex matrices.
